SELECT bp.post_id, bp.board_type_code, bp.user_id, bp.title, bp.content, bp.visibility_status, bp.pinned_yn, bp.created_at, bp.view_count, bp.updated_at, bp.deleted_yn,
grd.report_category_code, grd.error_type_code, grd.process_status_code, grd.target_data_name, grd.address, grd.latitude, grd.longitude, grd.sido, grd.sigungu, grd.eupmyeondong, grd.created_at AS report_created_at, grd.updated_at AS report_updated_at FROM sd_board_post bp INNER JOIN sd_gis_report_detail grd ON bp.post_id = grd.post_id WHERE bp.board_type_code = 'GIS_REPORT' AND bp.deleted_yn = 'N' AND bp.visibility_status = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY bp.created_at DESC
